      <h1 class="talk-title">How AI Is Used in My Job: From Data to Better Business Decisions</h1>

      <!-- Main Description -->
      <section class="talk-description">
        In this six-minute talk, Priya will share a practical perspective on how Artificial Intelligence is being used in her day-to-day work. She will explore how AI supports data analysis, helps uncover meaningful insights, improves efficiency, and enables better business decision-making. The session will provide a simple, real-world view of how AI is moving from a buzzword to a valuable tool in the workplace.
      </section>

Priya brings these skills together to transform data into meaningful insights and explore how AI and analytics can be applied to real-world business challenges, improve efficiency, and support smarter decision-making.
